section.title: Overview
section.para: This module ships structured log entries from the Kamailio configuration script to a VictoriaLogs server. The entries are formatted as JSON lines and sent over HTTP to the VictoriaLogs

Logging is asynchronous: the SIP worker processes only pack the values of the log entry and pass them to a dedicated sender process. The sender process serializes the entries to JSON, collects them in a queue and posts them in batches, so the SIP processing is never blocked by the HTTP transfer.

The set of fields of a log entry is described by log groups. A log group is defined with the default_map and map parameters and is referenced by its key as the first argument of the vl_log() function. Fields of the default map are filled automatically (current time, route name, pseudo-variables, static values), fields of the map are filled from the arguments of vl_log().

section.title: &kamailio; Modules
section.para:
The following modules must be loaded before this module:
pv - needed when pseudo-variables are used in default_map or in the text arguments of vl_log(), which is the case in any practical configuration.

section.title: External Libraries or Applications
section.para:
The following libraries or applications must be installed before running &kamailio; with this module loaded:
libcurl.
The module is available only on Linux: the sender process is built on epoll and timerfd.

section.title: target (str)
section.para: URL of the VictoriaLogs jsonline ingestion endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9428/insert/jsonline. The parameter can be set multiple times to configure several targets.

para.emphasis: Default value is empty (at least one target is required).

section.title: stream_fields (str)
section.para: Comma-separated list of field names that identify the log stream in VictoriaLogs. The value is passed in the VL-Stream-Fields HTTP header. The fields should have a small number of distinct values (host name, application name, log group).

para.emphasis: Default value is empty (all entries go to the default stream).

section.title: msg_field (str)
section.para: Name of the field that VictoriaLogs should use as the log message (_msg). The value is passed in the VL-Msg-Field HTTP header. Alternatively the field can be named _msg directly in the map.

para.emphasis: Default value is empty (VictoriaLogs uses the _msg field).

section.title: time_field (str)
section.para: Name of the field that VictoriaLogs should use as the log entry timestamp (_time). The value is passed in the VL-Time-Field HTTP header. Alternatively the field can be named _time directly in the default map. When no time field is present, VictoriaLogs uses the ingestion time.

para.emphasis: Default value is empty (VictoriaLogs uses the _time field).

section.title: extra_fields (str)
section.para: Comma-separated list of name=value pairs added by VictoriaLogs to every ingested entry. The value is passed in the VL-Extra-Fields HTTP header.

section.title: account_id (int)
section.para: VictoriaLogs tenant account id, sent in the AccountID HTTP header together with project_id. The headers are only sent when at least one of the two is greater than zero.

section.title: project_id (int)
section.para: VictoriaLogs tenant project id, sent in the ProjectID HTTP header. See account_id.

section.title: auth_username (str)
section.para: User name for HTTP basic authentication on the targets. The authentication is enabled when both auth_username and auth_password are set.

section.title: auth_password (str)
section.para: Password for HTTP basic authentication on the targets. See auth_username.

section.title: timeout (int)
section.para: Maximum duration of one HTTP request in milliseconds. A request that takes longer is treated as failed and the batch is retried on the next target.

section.title: batch_size (int)
section.para: Maximum number of log entries in one HTTP request. When the number of queued entries exceeds this value, a request is sent immediately without waiting for batch_delay.

para.emphasis: Default value is 0 (no limit, the whole queue is sent in one request).

section.title: batch_delay (int)
section.para: Interval in milliseconds between the sending of the queued entries. The minimum value is 100.

section.title: queue_size (int)
section.para: Maximum number of log entries kept in the queue of the sender process. When the limit is exceeded (e.g. all targets are down), new entries are dropped, an error is logged and the vl_drop_total statistic is incremented.

section.title: default_map (str)
section.para: Fields of a log group that are filled automatically on every vl_log() call. The format of the value is described in the section Format of default_map and map parameters. The parameter can be set multiple times, once per log group.

section.title: map (str)
section.para: Fields of a log group that are filled from the arguments of the vl_log() function. The format of the value is described in the section Format of default_map and map parameters. The parameter can be set multiple times, once per log group.

para.emphasis: Default value is empty (at least one map is required).

section.title: Format of default_map and map parameters
section.para: The value of both parameters has the format key(name:type[, name:type ...]).

listitem.para: key - name of the log group, used as the first argument of vl_log().
name - name of the JSON field in the log entry. The VictoriaLogs special fields _msg, _time and the stream fields can be used directly.
type - type of the field, see below.

section.para: Types allowed in default_map:

listitem.para: timestamp - current time in RFC3339 format with millisecond precision (UTC), e.g. 2026-10-06T08:09:41.123Z.
route_name - name of the route block from which vl_log() is called.
$... - a pseudo-variable, its value is taken at the time of the call (e.g. $si, $ci, $var(x)). Null values result in the field being omitted.

section.para: Types allowed in map:

listitem.para: text - string. The argument may contain pseudo-variables, they are evaluated at the time of the call. Empty strings are omitted from the entry.
bool - boolean, the argument must be true, false or a number (non-zero is true).
inet - IPv4 or IPv6 address, stored as a string.
date - date and time in local time zone in the format %Y.%m.%d %H:%M:%S, stored in RFC3339 format (UTC).

section.para: Build a log entry of the log group key and pass it to the sender process. The number of values must be equal to the number of fields in the map of the group, and each value must match the type of the corresponding field. Up to 5 values can be given.
Returns 1 on success and -1 on error (unknown group, wrong number or type of values, sender process not reachable).
This function can be used from ANY_ROUTE.

section.title: Queue algorithm
section.para: The sender process collects the log entries in a queue. Every batch_delay milliseconds, or as soon as the queue grows over batch_size entries, the first batch_size entries of the queue (the whole queue when batch_size is 0) are posted to the current target in one request. Only one request is in flight at a time.

On success the entries are removed from the queue and the next batch is sent immediately if the queue is not empty. On failure the vl_err_total statistic is incremented and the same batch is retried on the next target. When all the targets failed, the entries stay in the queue until the next batch_delay tick.
When the queue holds more than queue_size entries, new entries are dropped and vl_drop_total is incremented.
